import hashlib,json,shutil,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/workspace/android-studio-reference-membership')
E=Path('/workspace/android-studio-artifacts/reference-runner-membership')
R=E/'runtime';C=E/'cli-inputs';C.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
binding=json.loads((R/'xtask-build-compiler-binding.json').read_text()); binary=Path(binding['executable']);expected=binding['sha256']
assert hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected
selection=ROOT/'tooling/xtask/test_data/reference_membership/selection.json';sources=ROOT/'tooling/xtask/test_data/reference_membership/sources';output=R/'actual-membership.json'
records=[]
def case(name,expected_exit,source=sources,selected=selection,out=output,check=False):
 assert hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected
 command=[str(binary),'android-reference-membership','--source-root',str(source),'--selection',str(selected),'--output',str(out)]
 if check:command.append('--check')
 result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(E/'run-gate.py'),name,*command],cwd=ROOT,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 (R/(name+'-runner.log')).write_bytes(result.stdout)
 assert result.returncode==expected_exit,(name,result.returncode,result.stdout.decode())
 receipt=json.loads((R/(name+'.json')).read_text());assert receipt['exit_code']==expected_exit and receipt['full_source_index_status_unchanged']
 assert hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected
 records.append({'name':name,'expected_exit':expected_exit,'actual_exit':result.returncode,'receipt':str(R/(name+'.json'))})
case('cli-create',0);created=output.read_bytes();case('cli-check',0,check=True);assert output.read_bytes()==created
case('cli-existing-output-rejected',1);assert output.read_bytes()==created
mismatch=R/'mismatched-existing.json';mismatch.write_bytes(b'unchanged sentinel\n');case('cli-check-mismatch-rejected',1,out=mismatch,check=True);assert mismatch.read_bytes()==b'unchanged sentinel\n'
for field,value in [('revision','incorrect'),('path','../unsafe'),('bytes',999)]:
 document=json.loads(selection.read_text());document['files'][0][field]=value;selected=C/(field+'-wrong.json');selected.write_text(json.dumps(document)+'\n');case('cli-'+field+'-rejected',1,selected=selected,out=R/(field+'-must-not-exist.json'));assert not (R/(field+'-must-not-exist.json')).exists()
duplicate=json.loads(selection.read_text());duplicate['files'][1]=duplicate['files'][0];selected=C/'duplicate.json';selected.write_text(json.dumps(duplicate)+'\n');case('cli-duplicate-rejected',1,selected=selected,out=R/'duplicate-must-not-exist.json');assert not (R/'duplicate-must-not-exist.json').exists()
budget=C/'selection-over-budget.json';budget.write_bytes(b' '*((256*1024)+1));case('cli-selection-budget-rejected',1,selected=budget,out=R/'budget-must-not-exist.json');assert not (R/'budget-must-not-exist.json').exists()
private=C/'altered-originals';shutil.copytree(sources,private);changed=private/'idea/adt-ui/BUILD';changed.write_bytes(changed.read_bytes()+b'# private negative\n');case('cli-changed-original-rejected',1,source=private,out=R/'changed-must-not-exist.json');assert not (R/'changed-must-not-exist.json').exists()
evidence=json.loads(created);assert evidence['global_census_complete'] is False and evidence['effective_runtime_cases'] is None and evidence['new_original_behavior_credit']==0 and evidence['applicability']=='unresolved';assert len(evidence['files'])==16 and [len(build['modules']) for build in evidence['build_files']]==[1,2]
result={'schema_version':1,'source_commit':binding['source_commit'],'compiled_executable_sha256':expected,'cases':records,'case_count':len(records),'all_expected_results_passed':True,'actual_output_sha256':hashlib.sha256(created).hexdigest(),'actual_output_bytes':len(created),'new_original_behavior_credit':0,'effective_runtime_cases':None,'global_census_complete':False}
(R/'actual-cli-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
